unit.mapping: 1:1 at same logical width; map path also uses filletRadiusMeters

notes: Render-only fillet at sharp vertices. Stored GPS / distance metrics must not change. Apply after stretch-split so casing→fill z-order and stretch boundaries use smoothed coords.
methodNotes: At vertex B with turn ≥ minTurnDegrees: cut T1/T2 along adjacent edges by along=min(r/tan(θ/2), maxAlong, 0.45·segLen); replace B with quadratic Bézier samples T1→B→T2 (arcSamples interior). Straight / gentle turns keep the vertex.
